column1: # kind: evidence  vertex key <TAB> geometry key: pairs drawn with a lean passthrough geometry shader, each built as one mesh library (dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_mesh.py). Donkey Kong
# Bananza draws its geometry draws with these pairs: non-instanced, non-indirect triangle lists without restart, whose vertex shaders have a pulling entry. The first is every
# geometry draw of its first level (about 600 a frame); the second, the same geometry shader after another SilverStarMaterial vertex variant, was every draw the host's
# "geometry compute path" line counted in a 2026-11-09 session (50,000-225,000 per log window, all "no mesh library"); the third, a SilverStarMaterial variant (var14) too, is
# the 3D map's terrain: panning the map of Sublayer 900 drew it through the compute path, up to 665,000 draws per log window of 300 frames, 25 fps (2026-11-14)
